item.title: ESA Sentinel-1D delivers first high-resolution images
item.description:
📝 First images show fragility of glaciers Antarctic Peninsula by Sentinel-1D The Antarctic Peninsula (above) is part of the larger peninsula of West Antarctica, protruding 1300 km. The details shown in this image from Sentinel-1D remind us of the fragility of glaciers in the Antarctic. This image also uses multiple radar polarisations to capture enhanced data on the landscape.
🔗 Read more: https://www.esa.int/Applications/Observing_the_Earth/Copernicus/Sentinel-1/Sentinel-1D_delivers_first_images_from_Antarctica_to_Bremen

item.title: Langjam Gamejam: Build a programming language then make a game with it
item.description:
📝 Langjam Gamejam is a 7-day challenge to create a programming language and then use that language to build a game. There will be prizes for the most creative submissions. Rules The hackathon runs for 7 days You must design and implement a programming language You must design and implement a game using your language You can use any language, engine, libraries, and technologies You define what a programming language is and what a game is Work solo or on a team Documentation and instructions are encouraged Bonus points: Write a blog post about your language, game, and design process Join the jam and submit on Itch.
🔗 Read more: https://langjamgamejam.com/
